text.p: The following are the reports carried by Estonia's newspapers on Monday. Reuters has not verified these reports and does not vouch for their accuracy:
- The acting director of the police department said low salaries wouls soon prevent police from effectively carrying out their duties.
- Five Council of Europe conventions regulating assistance between countries in solving criminal cases will come in force in Estonia by August 1.
- Parnu economic cooperative demands that the sale of four stores that the cooperative's board carried out without informing the members be cancelled.
- The European Bank for Reconstruction and Development will open a credit line of DEM 12 million for the Estonian Union bank to finance housing loans.
